{{Term/Store|Nellie||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring character in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite|Nellie|Game Screen|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Nellie|Game Screen|TotK}}</ref>

==Biography==
==={{BotW|-}}===
Nellie is an elderly [[Gerudo]] woman who resides in [[Gerudo Town]]. She resides in the [[House]] across from the [[Gerudo Secret Club]] with her granddaughter, [[Risa]]. While she is awake, she frequents the [[Stall]]s in the center of Town. If [[Link]] speaks to Nellie, she finds it interesting to see a "Hylian vai" and greets him.<ref>{{Cite|A Hylian vai, huh... Sav'aaq...|Nellie|BotW}}</ref>

At 11:00 PM, Nellie can be found in front of [[Lorn's Fruit Stand]]. When spoken to, she recounts that her grandmother often told her never to eat [[Hearty Durian]]s while drinking.<ref name="Vaba"/> While she does not know the reason why, she believes there must be a good reason due to how often her grandmother repeated it.<ref>{{Cite|I don't really know why, but since she said it so much, there must be a good reason.|Nellie|BotW}}</ref> At 5:00 AM, she leaves to look for a drink and snacks.<ref>{{Cite|I think I'll look for something to drink and maybe some snacks...|Nellie|BotW}}</ref>

After visiting Lorn's Fruit Stand, she oserves [[Ardin]]'s [[General Store]], which sells [[Mushroom]]s. If Link speaks to her, she says that her mother taught her that [[Food]] made from Mushrooms help relieve strong headaches.<ref name="Mom"/> For that reason, Nellie always makes [[Fragrant Mushroom Sauté]] for herself whenever she is tired.<ref>{{Cite|So...when I'm feeling tired, I always make {{Color BotW|Blue|fragrant mushroom sauté}}. I love that curry flavor!|Nellie|BotW}}</ref> She then explains how to make the dish by [[Cooking]] [[Goron Spice]] with any Mushroom.<ref>{{Cite|It's a simple dish that you can make if you have some {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron spice}} and {{Color BotW|Blue|mushrooms}}.|Nellie|BotW}}</ref>

When Ardin's entire stock is sold out, Nellie is initially hesitant to believe that she is selling Mushrooms that only beautiful people can see.<ref>{{Cite|Mushrooms that only beautiful people can see? Not like I'll fall for that. Wait, you're not seriously saying you can see them, are you?|Nellie|BotW}}</ref> If Link claims he can see them, Nellie admits that she thought Ardin was lying so her customers would not know she was out of stock.<ref>{{Cite|[Yup, I can see them.] Oh, wow, really? And I just thought it was all some kind of joke that Ardin came up with to trick her customers when she's all out...|Nellie|BotW}}</ref> While she does not care if she can see them or not, she believes she would have been able to see them when she was younger.<ref>{{Cite|Well, I don't care if I can see them or not. I could have seen them when I was younger—that much I know.|Nellie|BotW}}</ref> If Link admits he cannot see them, Nellie reasons that if someone as beautiful as him is unable to, then Ardin must be lying.<ref>{{Cite|[I can't see them.] Oh, well, if someone as pretty as you can't see them, that means... Then Ardin must have made up another silly lie. She tells really weird ones sometimes.|Nellie|BotW}}</ref>

At 10:00 AM, Nellie leaves the market to sleep in her [[Bed]], as she wants to avoid the [[Heat]] of the day.<ref>{{Cite|It's gonna get hot soon, so I think I'm going to head to bed.|Nellie|BotW}}</ref> If Link speaks to Nellie while she is sleeping in her home, she irritably asks what he wants and says that she prefers to sleep until night falls.<ref>{{Cite|Ugh, what is it? I prefer to rest and relax until night...|Nellie|BotW}}</ref> After Nellie wakes up at 5:00 PM, she wonders how people tolerate the Heat, as she likes the night more, before deciding to wake herself up with a drink.<ref>{{Cite|The nighttime is really nice. I can't believe how much people move around in the heat of the afternoon. I guess I could get a drink to wake myself up...|Nellie|BotW}}</ref> She then goes to [[The Noble Canteen]], where she remarks that drinking is the only way she can wake up.<ref>{{Cite|Phew! This is really the only thing that can wake me up.|Nellie|BotW}}</ref> She stays there until 11:00 PM, before leaving for Lorn's Fruit Stand.

==Nomenclature==
Many [[Gerudo]] in {{BotW}} and {{TotK}} are named for real-world cosmetics or beauty items. "Nellie" may derive from ''nail''.

Additionally, Nellie is a common diminutive for the name "Nell."<ref>{{Cite Web|published= April 25, 2021 |retrieved= November 13, 2022 |url= https://www.behindthename.com/name/nellie |archive= https://web.archive.org/web/20220520022015/https://www.behindthename.com/name/nellie |title= Meaning, origin and history of the name Nellie |site= Behind the Name}}</ref>
